mapper.select: select cs.id, cs.class_id, c.class_name, cs.term_id, t.term_name, cs.join_time, cs.leave_time, cs.is_current from edu_class_student cs left join edu_class c on c.class_id = cs.class_id left join edu_term t on t.term_id = cs.term_id where cs.user_id = #{userId} and cs.is_current = '1' order by cs.is_current desc, cs.join_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into edu_transfer_log (user_id, transfer_type, from_id, to_id, from_name, to_name, term_id, operator_id, operate_time, remark) values (#{userId}, #{transferType}, #{fromId}, #{toId}, #{fromName}, #{toName}, #{termId}, #{operatorId}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select count(1) from edu_group_member gm join edu_group g on g.group_id = gm.group_id where g.class_id = #{classId} and g.task_id is not null and gm.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update edu_group_member set group_id = #{toGroupId} where group_id = #{fromGroupId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from edu_group_member where group_id = #{groupId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into edu_group_member (group_id, user_id, confirm_status, join_time) values (#{groupId}, #{userId}, 1, sysdate())
